The killing centre at Bełżec used stationary gas chambers modelled on technology developed under Aktion T4. These officers were selected by Odilo Globočnik to augment the personnel managing the death camps. These officers brought their prior experience from forced euthanasia centres to design and run the extermination program. The expertise and personnel from Aktion T4 were directly transferred to and instrumental in the functioning of Operation Reinhard's death camps.
